$comment: Toolchain + compiler flags. Translation units live in splits.txt.
$flags_note: Prohibited: -fshort-wchar, -fpack-struct.  The SDK default is gnu++14; we use gnu++17
because the sead/al/nn community headers need it (no codegen difference seen so far).
-mno-implicit-float: no SIMD registers for integer/pointer data. Matches LMSi_MemCopy (no
loop vectorization) and BgmStopObj's ctor/Functor copies (GPR ldp/stp, no SLP q-regs).
alone is not enough, and in clang 8 it must come after -O3 to take effect.)
-fno-strict-aliasing (C, LMS): the game reloads through pointers after every store.
-fno-rtti: only NintendoWare has typeinfo in the binary; game/al/sead do not.
No -ffunction-sections/-fdata-sections: objects get one .text/.data/... section, like the
carved targets (inline/template code still gets its own COMDAT .text.<name> section).
On non-Windows hosts the same clang.exe runs under wine (tools/nxcc.py).
$include_note: Headers under al/sead/agl/eui/nnheaders/Game started from the 3dcomp project.
